text:
alex_support: Heads-up — planning a short maintenance window tonight 00:30-01:30 UTC for a runtime kernel patch. Affects hosted API token-serving on eu / ap regions only; Dedicated and Private should be unaffected. Need statuspage + customer email.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: maintenance/kernel-quant-opt-2026-03-21 at 2026-03-21T00:30:00Z -> 2026-03-21T01:30:00Z. Rollout strategy: staggered (eu -> ap -> na), canary in eu-west-1. Autoretry enabled.

jen_eng_oncall: +1. Canary tomorrow is good. Recommend pin fallback ready: pin to model-runtime v2026-03-18-stable in case of regressions. If p95 latency > 220ms for 10m or error rate > 3% we hold and pin.

mike_devex: Can we get a short customer-friendly status blurb? We should avoid engineering jargon but mention possible transient errors and that we're minimizing impact. Also include region list.

sasha_support: Draft statuspage snippet: "We will perform a routine runtime update in EU and AP regions between 00:30–01:30 UTC. During this period, some hosted API requests may experience short delays or transient errors. We expect the update to be completed within the window; Dedicated and Private deployments are not impacted. We'll post progress updates here." Thoughts? :eyes:

nisha_product: Good. Add a line about how customers on Dedicated can contact their account team for a post-check if they want confirmation. Also put a link to our incident page if they need live updates.

jen_eng_oncall: One more: include rollback criteria in internal comms only — customers don't need the thresholds. Internal note: rollback if canary error spike > 3% or latency regressions > 15% sustained for 10m. Use pin to v2026-03-18-stable as automatic fallback.

alex_support: Sasha — can you craft the email subject + 2-sentence body? Keep it customer-facing and short.

sasha_support: Email subject: "Planned maintenance: short update to hosted API (EU, AP) — Mar 21, 00:30 UTC"

sasha_support: Email body (2 lines): "We’ll perform a routine update to our inference runtime on Mar 21 between 00:30–01:30 UTC affecting EU and AP regions. Some hosted API requests may see brief delays or transient errors; Dedicated and Private customers are unaffected. For live progress see status.redwood.ai."

mike_devex: Pinged docs to add a single-line note to the quickstart about regional maintenance windows.

deploy-bot: Canary started in eu-west-1 — 5% traffic. Health: OK (latency +0.8%, errors 0.2%). Monitoring hooks active.

jen_eng_oncall: Will monitor. If anything looks off we'll flip pin. I’ll post hold/rollback decision in this thread.

statusbot: Reminder scheduled: post statuspage update at 2026-03-21T00:25:00Z (5m before window).

alex_support: Quick checklist before publish: 1) Support email queued (sasha) 2) Statuspage snippet set (sasha) 3) Ops pins ready (jen) 4) Canary monitor dashboard link in the thread (jen) 5) Customer comms approval (nisha). Anyone object?

sasha_support: All set from my side. Posting drafts to the statuspage tool now.

nisha_product: Approved. No objections.

jen_eng_oncall: Canary steady. Publishing final internal runbook to the ops channel now. Will update here if we hit hold.

alex_support: Thanks all — will send the scheduled email 10m before. If we need to escalate, call with eng-oncall + support ops. :phone:
